requirements.condition: When encoding or parsing a PATH_CHALLENGE frame
requirements.required_behavior: The frame Type field has the value 0x1a.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: A PATH_CHALLENGE frame must not use any other type value.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded frame type can be inspected and compared with the fixed value 0x1a.

requirements.condition: When encoding or parsing a PATH_CHALLENGE frame
requirements.required_behavior: The Data field is exactly 64 bits long.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Data field must not have a length other than 64 bits.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded Data field length can be measured directly.

requirements.quote: Data:  This 8-byte field contains arbitrary data.
requirements.condition: When encoding or parsing the Data field of a PATH_CHALLENGE frame
requirements.required_behavior: The Data field is exactly 8 bytes and its contents may be any byte value.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The implementation must not encode the Data field with a length other than 8 bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The field length and acceptance of arbitrary byte sequences can be tested with encoded frames.

requirements.quote:
Including 64 bits of entropy in a PATH_CHALLENGE frame ensures that
   it is easier to receive the packet than it is to guess the value
   correctly.
requirements.why_checkable: The passage describes a security property of using 64 bits of entropy, but it does not clearly require implementations to generate the Data value with that entropy.

requirements.quote:
The recipient of this frame MUST generate a PATH_RESPONSE frame
   (Section 19.18) containing the same Data value.
requirements.condition: When an endpoint receives a PATH_CHALLENGE frame
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint generates a PATH_RESPONSE frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint must not omit generation of the PATH_RESPONSE frame.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver a PATH_CHALLENGE frame and observe whether the recipient generates a PATH_RESPONSE frame.

requirements.quote:
The recipient of this frame MUST generate a PATH_RESPONSE frame
   (Section 19.18) containing the same Data value.
requirements.condition: When generating the PATH_RESPONSE frame required in response to a received PATH_CHALLENGE frame
requirements.required_behavior: The PATH_RESPONSE contains exactly the Data value from the received PATH_CHALLENGE frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint must not place a different Data value in the generated PATH_RESPONSE frame.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can compare the received PATH_CHALLENGE Data value with the Data value in the generated PATH_RESPONSE.
